verses.en: The LORD’s word that came to Joel, the son of Pethuel.
verses.zh: 耶和华的话临到毗土珥的儿子约珥。

words.g: Joel, the name of twelve Israelites

verses.en: Hear this, you elders, and listen, all you inhabitants of the land! Has this ever happened in your days, or in the days of your fathers?
verses.zh: 老年人哪，当听我的话；国中的居民哪，都要侧耳而听。在你们的日子，或你们列祖的日子，曾有这样的事吗？

words.g: and + to broaden out the ear , i.e.  to listen
and + used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
father, in a literal and immediate + +you/your

verses.en: Tell your children about it, and have your children tell their children, and their children, another generation.
verses.zh: 你们要将这事传与子，子传与孙，孙传与后代。

words.g: to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e.  to inscribe

verses.en: What the swarming locust has left, the great locust has eaten. What the great locust has left, the grasshopper has eaten. What the grasshopper has left, the caterpillar has eaten.
verses.zh: 剪虫剩下的，蝗虫来吃；蝗虫剩下的，蝻子来吃；蝻子剩下的，蚂蚱来吃。

words.g: and + an overhanging, i.e.  an excess
and + an overhanging, i.e.  an excess
the + the ravager, i.e. a locust

verses.en: Wake up, you drunkards, and weep! Wail, all you drinkers of wine, because of the sweet wine, for it is cut off from your mouth.
verses.zh: 酒醉的人哪，要清醒哭泣；好酒的人哪，都要为甜酒哀号，因为从你们的口中断绝了。

words.g: intoxicated, as astate or a habit
from + the mouth , whether literal or figurative + +you/your

verses.en: For a nation has come up on my land, strong, and without number. His teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he has the fangs of a lioness.
verses.zh: 有一队蝗虫（原文是民）又强盛又无数，侵犯我的地；它的牙齿如狮子的牙齿，大牙如母狮的大牙。

words.g: and + a biter, i.e. a tooth

verses.en: He has laid my vine waste, and stripped my fig tree. He has stripped its bark, and thrown it away. Its branches are made white.
verses.zh: 它毁坏我的葡萄树，剥了我无花果树的皮，剥尽而丢弃，使枝条露白。

words.g: to strip off, i.e. generally to make naked
to strip off, i.e. generally to make naked + +her/its

verses.en: Mourn like a virgin dressed in sackcloth for the husband of her youth!
verses.zh: 我的民哪，你当哀号，像处女腰束麻布，为幼年的丈夫哀号。

words.g: youth, the state  or the persons + +her/its

verses.en: The meal offering and the drink offering are cut off from the LORD’s house. The priests, the LORD’s ministers, mourn.
verses.zh: 素祭和奠祭从耶和华的殿中断绝；事奉耶和华的祭司都悲哀。

words.g: to attend as a menial or worshipper

verses.en: The field is laid waste. The land mourns, for the grain is destroyed, The new wine has dried up, and the oil languishes.
verses.zh: 田荒凉，地悲哀；因为五谷毁坏，新酒干竭，油也缺乏。

verses.en: Be confounded, you farmers! Wail, you vineyard keepers, for the wheat and for the barley; for the harvest of the field has perished.
verses.zh: 农夫啊，你们要惭愧；修理葡萄园的啊，你们要哀号；因为大麦小麦与田间的庄稼都灭绝了。

words.g: to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed
wheat, whether the grain or the plant

verses.en: The vine has dried up, and the fig tree withered— the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, even all of the trees of the field are withered; for joy has withered away from the sons of men.
verses.zh: 葡萄树枯干；无花果树衰残。石榴树、棕树、苹果树，连田野一切的树木也都枯干；众人的喜乐尽都消灭。

words.g: the + a vine , especially the grape
a pomegranate, the tree  or the fruit
and + an apple , i.e. the fruit or the tree

verses.en: Put on sackcloth and mourn, you priests! Wail, you ministers of the altar. Come, lie all night in sackcloth, you ministers of my God, for the meal offering and the drink offering are withheld from your God’s house.
verses.zh: 祭司啊，你们当腰束麻布痛哭；伺候祭坛的啊，你们要哀号；事奉我神的啊，你们要来披上麻布过夜，因为素祭和奠祭从你们神的殿中断绝了。

words.g: and + to tear the hair and beat the breasts
to attend as a menial or worshipper
to attend as a menial or worshipper
to debar  from benefit or injury

verses.en: Sanctify a fast. Call a solemn assembly. Gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land to the house of the LORD, your God, and cry to the LORD.
verses.zh: 你们要分定禁食的日子，宣告严肃会，招聚长老和国中的一切居民到耶和华―你们神的殿，向耶和华哀求。

words.g: an assembly, especially on afestival or holiday

verses.en: Alas for the day! For the day of the LORD is at hand, and it will come as destruction from the Almighty.
verses.zh: 哀哉！耶和华的日子临近了。这日来到，好像毁灭从全能者来到。

verses.en: Isn’t the food cut off before our eyes, joy and gladness from the house of our God?
verses.zh: 粮食不是在我们眼前断绝了吗？欢喜快乐不是从我们神的殿中止息了吗？

verses.en: The seeds rot under their clods. The granaries are laid desolate. The barns are broken down, for the grain has withered.
verses.zh: 谷种在土块下朽烂；仓也荒凉，廪也破坏；因为五谷枯干了。

words.g: something thrown off , i.e. a clod + +them/their
to stun , i.e. devastate or  stupefy
to pull down or in pieces, break

verses.en: How the animals groan! The herds of livestock are perplexed, because they have no pasture. Yes, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.
verses.zh: 牲畜哀鸣；牛群混乱，因为无草；羊群也受了困苦。

verses.en: LORD, I cry to you, for the fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame has burned all the trees of the field.
verses.zh: 耶和华啊，我向你求告，因为火烧灭旷野的草场；火焰烧尽田野的树木。

verses.en: Yes, the animals of the field pant to you, for the water brooks have dried up, and the fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness.
verses.zh: 田野的走兽向你发喘；因为溪水干涸，火也烧灭旷野的草场。

verses.en: Blow the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain! Let all the inhabitants of the land tremble, for the day of the LORD comes, for it is close at hand:
verses.zh: 你们要在锡安吹角，在我圣山吹出大声。国中的居民都要发颤；因为耶和华的日子将到，已经临近。

words.g: in + Tsijon , a mountain of Jerusalem

verses.en: A day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness. As the dawn spreading on the mountains, a great and strong people; there has never been the like, neither will there be any more after them, even to the years of many generations.
verses.zh: 那日是黑暗、幽冥、密云、乌黑的日子，好像晨光铺满山岭。有一队蝗虫（原文是民）又大又强；从来没有这样的，以后直到万代也必没有。

words.g: a cloud , i.e. the nimbus or thunder-cloud
a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately  as + +him/his/it

verses.en: A fire devours before them, and behind them, a flame burns. The land is as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them, a desolate wilderness. Yes, and no one has escaped them.
verses.zh: 它们前面如火烧灭，后面如火焰烧尽。未到以前，地如伊甸园；过去以后，成了荒凉的旷野；没有一样能躲避它们的。

words.g: Eden, the region of Adam's home

verses.en: Their appearance is as the appearance of horses, and they run as horsemen.
verses.zh: 它们的形状如马，奔跑如马兵。

verses.en: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of the mountains, they leap, like the noise of a flame of fire that devours the stubble, like a strong people set in battle array.
verses.zh: 在山顶蹦跳的响声如车辆的响声，又如火焰烧碎秸的响声，好像强盛的民摆阵预备打仗。

words.g: to stamp, i.e. to spring about
to set in a row, i.e. arrange

verses.en: At their presence the peoples are in anguish. All faces have grown pale.
verses.zh: 它们一来，众民伤恸，脸都变色。

words.g: to twist or whirl , i.e.  to dance

verses.en: They run like mighty men. They climb the wall like warriors. They each march in his line, and they don’t swerve off course.
verses.zh: 它们如勇士奔跑，像战士爬城；各都步行，不乱队伍。

verses.en: One doesn’t jostle another. They each march in their own path. They burst through the defenses and don’t break ranks.
verses.zh: 彼此并不拥挤，向前各行其路，直闯兵器，不偏左右。

words.g: in + a thoroughfare , literally or figuratively + +him/his/it
the + a missile of attack, i.e. spear

verses.en: They rush on the city. They run on the wall. They climb up into the houses. They enter in at the windows like thieves.
verses.zh: 它们蹦上城，蹿上墙，爬上房屋，进入窗户如同盗贼。

verses.en: The earth quakes before them. The heavens tremble. The sun and the moon are darkened, and the stars withdraw their shining.
verses.zh: 它们一来，地震天动，日月昏暗，星宿无光。

verses.en: The LORD thunders his voice before his army, for his forces are very great; for he is strong who obeys his command; for the day of the LORD is great and very awesome, and who can endure it?
verses.zh: 耶和华在他军旅前发声，他的队伍甚大；成就他命的是强盛者。因为耶和华的日子大而可畏，谁能当得起呢？

verses.en: “Yet even now,” says the LORD, “turn to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning.”
verses.zh: 耶和华说：虽然如此，你们应当禁食、哭泣、悲哀，一心归向我。

verses.en: Tear your heart and not your garments, and turn to the LORD, your God; for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and relents from sending calamity.
verses.zh: 你们要撕裂心肠，不撕裂衣服。归向耶和华―你们的神；因为他有恩典，有怜悯，不轻易发怒，有丰盛的慈爱，并且后悔不降所说的灾。

words.g: and + to rend, literally or figuratively

verses.en: Who knows? He may turn and relent, and leave a blessing behind him, even a meal offering and a drink offering to the LORD, your God.
verses.zh: 或者他转意后悔，留下余福，就是留下献给耶和华―你们神的素祭和奠祭，也未可知。

words.g: and + to swell up, i.e. be  redundant

verses.en: Blow the trumpet in Zion! Sanctify a fast. Call a solemn assembly.
verses.zh: 你们要在锡安吹角，分定禁食的日子，宣告严肃会。

words.g: in + Tsijon , a mountain of Jerusalem
an assembly, especially on afestival or holiday

verses.en: Gather the people. Sanctify the assembly. Assemble the elders. Gather the children, and those who nurse from breasts. Let the bridegroom go out of his room, and the bride out of her chamber.
verses.zh: 聚集众民，使会众自洁：招聚老者，聚集孩童和吃奶的；使新郎出离洞房，新妇出离内室。

words.g: the breast of a woman or animal

verses.en: Let the priests, the ministers of the LORD, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, “Spare your people, LORD, and don’t give your heritage to reproach, that the nations should rule over them. Why should they say among the peoples, ‘Where is their God?’”
verses.zh: 事奉耶和华的祭司要在廊子和祭坛中间哭泣，说：耶和华啊，求你顾惜你的百姓，不要使你的产业受羞辱，列邦管辖他们。为何容列国的人说：「他们的神在哪里」呢？

words.g: to attend as a menial or worshipper

verses.en: Then the LORD was jealous for his land, and had pity on his people.
verses.zh: 耶和华就为自己的地发热心，怜恤他的百姓。

words.g: and + to be  zealous, i.e.  jealous or envious

verses.en: The LORD answered his people, “Behold, I will send you grain, new wine, and oil, and you will be satisfied with them; and I will no more make you a reproach among the nations.
verses.zh: 耶和华应允他的百姓说：我必赐给你们五谷、新酒，和油，使你们饱足；我也不再使你们受列国的羞辱；

words.g: and + the + must or fresh grape-juice

verses.en: But I will remove the northern army far away from you, and will drive it into a barren and desolate land, its front into the eastern sea, and its back into the western sea; and its stench will come up, and its bad smell will rise.” Surely he has done great things.
verses.zh: 却要使北方来的军队远离你们，将他们赶到干旱荒废之地：前队赶入东海，后队赶入西海；因为他们所行的大恶（原文是事），臭气上升，腥味腾空。

words.g: to widen , i.e.  recede or  remove

verses.en: Land, don’t be afraid. Be glad and rejoice, for the LORD has done great things.
verses.zh: 地土啊，不要惧怕；要欢喜快乐，因为耶和华行了大事。

words.g: to spin round , i.e. usually rejoice

verses.en: Don’t be afraid, you animals of the field; for the pastures of the wilderness spring up, for the tree bears its fruit. The fig tree and the vine yield their strength.
verses.zh: 田野的走兽啊，不要惧怕；因为，旷野的草发生，树木结果，无花果树、葡萄树也都效力。

words.g: and + a vine , especially the grape
probably a force, whether of men + +them/their

verses.en: “Be glad then, you children of Zion, and rejoice in the LORD, your God; for he gives you the early rain in just measure, and he causes the rain to come down for you, the early rain and the latter rain, as before.
verses.zh: 锡安的民哪，你们要快乐，为耶和华―你们的神欢喜；因他赐给你们合宜的秋雨，为你们降下甘霖，就是秋雨、春雨，和先前一样。

words.g: to spin round , i.e. usually rejoice

verses.en: The threshing floors will be full of wheat, and the vats will overflow with new wine and oil.
verses.zh: 禾场必满了麦子；酒榨与油榨必有新酒和油盈溢。

words.g: and + to run after or over, i.e. overflow

verses.en: I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten, the great locust, the grasshopper, and the caterpillar, my great army, which I sent among you.
verses.zh: 我打发到你们中间的大军队，就是蝗虫、蝻子、蚂蚱、剪虫，那些年所吃的，我要补还你们。

words.g: and + the + the ravager, i.e. a locust
and + the + a kind of locust
probably a force, whether of men + +me/my

verses.en: You will have plenty to eat and be satisfied, and will praise the name of the LORD, your God, who has dealt wondrously with you; and my people will never again be disappointed.
verses.zh: 你们必多吃而得饱足，就赞美为你们行奇妙事之耶和华―你们神的名。我的百姓必永远不致羞愧。

words.g: to + perhaps to separate, i.e. distinguish
to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed

verses.en: You will know that I am among Israel, and that I am the LORD, your God, and there is no one else; and my people will never again be disappointed.
verses.zh: 你们必知道我是在以色列中间，又知道我是耶和华―你们的神；在我以外并无别神。我的百姓必永远不致羞愧。

words.g: in + the nearest part, i.e. the center
to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed

verses.en: “It will happen afterward, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh; and your sons and your daughters will prophesy. Your old men will dream dreams. Your young men will see visions.
verses.zh: 以后，我要将我的灵浇灌凡有血气的。你们的儿女要说预言；你们的老年人要做异梦，少年人要见异象。

words.g: and + to prophesy, i.e. speak  by inspiration
to bind firmly, i.e.  to be  plump

verses.en: And also on the servants and on the handmaids in those days, I will pour out my Spirit.
verses.zh: 在那些日子，我要将我的灵浇灌我的仆人和使女。

verses.en: I will show wonders in the heavens and on the earth: blood, fire, and pillars of smoke.
verses.zh: 「在天上地下，我要显出奇事，有血，有火，有烟柱。

verses.en: The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and terrible day of the LORD comes.
verses.zh: 日头要变为黑暗，月亮要变为血，这都在耶和华大而可畏的日子未到以前。

verses.en: It will happen that whoever will call on the LORD’s name shall be saved; for in Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be those who escape, as the LORD has said, and among the remnant, those whom the LORD calls.
verses.zh: 到那时候，凡求告耶和华名的就必得救；因为照耶和华所说的，在锡安山，耶路撒冷必有逃脱的人，在剩下的人中必有耶和华所召的。」

words.g: to be smooth, i.e.  to escape
and + in + Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: “For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I restore the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem,
verses.zh: 「到那日，我使犹大和耶路撒冷被掳之人归回的时候，

words.g: Jehudah , the name of five Israelites
and + Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: I will gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat; and I will execute judgment on them there for my people, and for my heritage, Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations. They have divided my land,
verses.zh: 我要聚集万民，带他们下到约沙法谷，在那里施行审判；因为他们将我的百姓，就是我的产业以色列，分散在列国中，又分取我的地土，

words.g: Jehoshaphat, the name of six Israelites
to scatter, whether in enmity or bounty

verses.en: and have cast lots for my people, and have given a boy for a prostitute, and sold a girl for wine, that they may drink.
verses.zh: 且为我的百姓拈阄，将童子换妓女，卖童女买酒喝。

words.g: the + something born, i.e. a lad or offspring

verses.en: “Yes, and what are you to me, Tyre and Sidon, and all the regions of Philistia? Will you repay me? And if you repay me, I will swiftly and speedily return your repayment on your own head.
verses.zh: 「泰尔、西顿，和非利士四境的人哪，你们与我何干？你们要报复我吗？若报复我，我必使报应速速归到你们的头上。

words.g: thou and thee, or  ye and you
and + Tsidon, the name of a son of Canaan
thou and thee, or  ye and you
and + used very widely as demonstrative, lo!
to treat a person , i.e. benefit or requite
thou and thee, or  ye and you

verses.en: Because you have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried my finest treasures into your temples,
verses.zh: 你们既然夺取我的金银，又将我可爱的宝物带入你们宫殿（或译：庙中），

verses.en: and have sold the children of Judah and the children of Jerusalem to the sons of the Greeks, that you may remove them far from their border.
verses.zh: 并将犹大人和耶路撒冷人卖给希腊人（原文是雅完人），使他们远离自己的境界。

words.g: Jehudah , the name of five Israelites
Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
the + a Jevanite, or descendant of Javan
to widen , i.e.  recede or  remove + +them/their

verses.en: Behold, I will stir them up out of the place where you have sold them, and will return your repayment on your own head;
verses.zh: 我必激动他们离开你们所卖到之地，又必使报应归到你们的头上。

verses.en: and I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hands of the children of Judah, and they will sell them to the men of Sheba, to a faraway nation, for the LORD has spoken it.”
verses.zh: 我必将你们的儿女卖在犹大人的手中，他们必卖给远方示巴国的人。这是耶和华说的。」

words.g: Jehudah , the name of five Israelites
to + a Shebaite or descendant of Sheba

verses.en: Proclaim this among the nations: “Prepare for war! Stir up the mighty men. Let all the warriors draw near. Let them come up.
verses.zh: 当在万民中宣告说：要预备打仗；激动勇士，使一切战士上前来。

verses.en: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruning hooks into spears. Let the weak say, ‘I am strong.’
verses.zh: 要将犁头打成刀剑，将镰刀打成戈矛；软弱的要说：我有勇力。

words.g: a hoe or other digging implement + +you/your

verses.en: Hurry and come, all you surrounding nations, and gather yourselves together.” Cause your mighty ones to come down there, LORD.
verses.zh: 四围的列国啊，你们要速速地来，一同聚集。耶和华啊，求你使你的大能者降临。

verses.en: “Let the nations arouse themselves, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat; for there I will sit to judge all the surrounding nations.
verses.zh: 万民都当兴起，上到约沙法谷；因为我必坐在那里，审判四围的列国。

words.g: Jehoshaphat, the name of six Israelites

verses.en: Put in the sickle; for the harvest is ripe. Come, tread, for the wine press is full, the vats overflow, for their wickedness is great.”
verses.zh: 开镰吧！因为庄稼熟了；践踏吧！因为酒榨满了。酒池盈溢；他们的罪恶甚大。

words.g: to run after or over, i.e. overflow

verses.en: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.
verses.zh: 许多许多的人在断定谷，因为耶和华的日子临近断定谷。

verses.en: The sun and the moon are darkened, and the stars withdraw their shining.
verses.zh: 日月昏暗，星宿无光。

verses.en: The LORD will roar from Zion, and thunder from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth will shake; but the LORD will be a refuge to his people, and a stronghold to the children of Israel.
verses.zh: 耶和华必从锡安吼叫，从耶路撒冷发声，天地就震动。耶和华却要作他百姓的避难所，作以色列人的保障。

words.g: from + Tsijon , a mountain of Jerusalem
and + from + Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
and + to undulate , particularly through fear

verses.en: “So you will know that I am the LORD, your God, dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain. Then Jerusalem will be holy, and no strangers will pass through her any more.
verses.zh: 你们就知道我是耶和华―你们的神，且又住在锡安―我的圣山。那时，耶路撒冷必成为圣；外邦人不再从其中经过。

words.g: in + Tsijon , a mountain of Jerusalem
Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: It will happen in that day, that the mountains will drop down sweet wine, the hills will flow with milk, all the brooks of Judah will flow with waters; and a fountain will flow out from the LORD’s house, and will water the valley of Shittim.
verses.zh: 到那日，大山要滴甜酒；小山要流奶子；犹大溪河都有水流。必有泉源从耶和华的殿中流出来，滋润什亭谷。

words.g: Jehudah , the name of five Israelites
and + to quaff, i.e.  to irrigate or furnish apotion to
a stream, especially a winter torrent
the + Shittim, a place East of the Jordan

verses.en: Egypt will be a desolation and Edom will be a desolate wilderness, for the violence done to the children of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.
verses.zh: 埃及必然荒凉，以东变为凄凉的旷野，都因向犹大人所行的强暴，又因在本地流无辜人的血。

words.g: Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt
and + Edom, the elder twin-brother of Jacob
Jehudah , the name of five Israelites

verses.en: But Judah will be inhabited forever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.
verses.zh: 但犹大必存到永远；耶路撒冷必存到万代。

words.g: and + Jehudah , the name of five Israelites
and + Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: I will cleanse their blood that I have not cleansed, for the LORD dwells in Zion.”
verses.zh: 我未曾报复（或译：洗除；下同）流血的罪，现在我要报复，因为耶和华住在锡安。

words.g: in + Tsijon , a mountain of Jerusalem
